title: DataFirst Study Data File
description: One data file belonging to a study in the DataFirst NADA microdata catalog, as returned by GET /catalog/data_files/{idno}. Field set observed live on 2026-08-30.

sid.description: Internal id of the owning study.

file_id.description: File id within the study (F1, F3, F4 ...).

case_count.description: Number of cases (rows) in the file.

var_count.description: Number of variables (columns) in the file.

metadata.description: Nested DDI file description, when present.
